title: ChronoScribe: Semantic-Numerical Specialization for Instruction-Driven Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.16345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in instruction-driven time series forecasting highlight a fundamental tension: systems must simultaneously master natural-language instruction following and precise numerical prediction. Current approaches often force a compromise. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret unstructured requests but may be inaccurate when asked to produce forecast values directly, whereas time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide numerical forecasts but typically require structured inputs specifying the target series, context window, and horizon. We present ChronoScribe, which applies semantic-numerical specialization to this workflow. A LoRA-adapted LLM proposes an execution path and context length; deterministic rules resolve the executable configuration. translated_title: ChronoScribe：面向指令驱动时间序列预测的语义-数值专业化
translated_abstract: 指令驱动时间序列预测的最新进展揭示了一个根本性矛盾：系统必须同时掌握自然语言指令理解和精确的数值预测。当前方法往往被迫做出折中：大语言模型（LLM）能够解读非结构化请求，但在被要求直接生成预测值时可能不准确；而时间序列基础模型（TSFM）能够提供数值预测，但通常需要以结构化输入指定目标序列、上下文窗口和预测时域。我们提出了ChronoScribe，将语义-数值专业化应用于这一工作流程：由一个经过LoRA适配的LLM提出执行路径和上下文长度，再由确定性规则解析出可执行的配置。在专家路径上，一个冻结的TSFM针对任务指定的预测时域生成分位数轨迹。确定性的轨迹摘要作为响应生成的条件，而LLM既不……
tldr: 该论文提出ChronoScribe框架，通过让LoRA适配的LLM负责解析自然语言指令并规划执行路径、由确定性规则确定配置、再由冻结的时间序列基础模型生成分位数预测轨迹，实现了语义理解与数值预测的分工专业化，从而兼顾指令遵循能力与数值预测精度。
en_tdlr: ChronoScribe achieves semantic-numerical specialization for instruction-driven forecasting by letting a LoRA-adapted LLM interpret instructions and propose an execution path, while deterministic rules resolve the configuration and a frozen time series foundation model produces precise quantile forecasts.
